latestTerminalSummary:
Two findings:

1. **P1 — Budget preflight omits B qualification.** [Plan:47](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/docs/v2-teacher-training-plan.md:47) requires full-budget-plus-600s clearance for curriculum stages; [plan:72](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/docs/v2-teacher-training-plan.md:72) covers E replication. [B protocol:59](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/docs/v2-teacher-training-plan.md:59) has neither a registered wall budget nor that preflight. B could open too late to complete all 2,000 teacher episodes, bootstrap, and receipts before cutoff. Cutoff stopping would consume the sole permitted campaign without completing qualification.

2. **P2 — Bootstrap RNG consumption remains unspecified.** [JSON:30](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/docs/teacher-qualification-v1.json:30) and [plan:70](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/docs/v2-teacher-training-plan.md:70) freeze seed, generator, resample count, statistic, and percentile method. Neither fixes generator reset scope, difficulty/metric draw order, or index reuse across metrics. Restarting PCG64 per difficulty versus consuming one stream across D2 then D3 produces different D3 bounds under the same declared configuration. Pin this schedule before results.

Threshold arithmetic, seed endpoints, baseline means, architecture, GAE boundaries, and stated checkpoint/resume rules otherwise agree. Static review only; supplied gate SHA not recomputed. M2 completion and teacher qualification remain unproven.
